field.domain: [('status', '=', 'active'), ('id', 'in', allowed_request_course_ids)] if restrict_request_courses and source == 'manual' else [('status', '=', 'active')]
field.placeholder: Select up to the configured number of courses...

field.name: proposed_program
field.invisible: request_level != 'work_unit' or not proposed_program or course_id or is_custom_course

field.name: recommended_course_id

button.name: action_view_recommended_course
button.invisible: request_level != 'work_unit' or not is_custom_course or not recommended_course_id
